show.sharing_text_v2:
हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा। 
https://links.kukufm.com/ndnnTU
show.description: A long-lost heir, Surya, returns to his dying father and reunites with his brother Dhruv, inheriting both duty and hidden power. As he navigates grief and a harsh class divide, Surya protects Dhruv’s love for Kashish against her powerful family, gradually revealing his own influence while confronting elite forces and preparing to change their fate in a clash of love, identity, and status.
